title: Jordan McDonald’s CV
text:
EDUCATION
Brigham Young University - Idaho Bachelor of Science, Financial Economics April 2027
Minor: Data Science
Current GPA: 3.990
EXPERIENCE
UNIQ Supply- Data Analytics Intern; Rexburg, ID Spring 2025
• Resolved extensive data inconsistency issues by standardizing 35K+ customer records in SQL, improving overall data accuracy, removing 65% of duplicate entries, and creating a cleaner foundation for analysis and reporting efficiency
• Automated customer profiling by building a Python web scraper that classified 12K+ businesses by industry, online presence, and activity level, reducing manual research time by 97% and producing cleaner, more actionable datasets
• Leveraged Power BI and R to conduct advanced customer segmentation analysis, identifying a four-order retention threshold and key seasonal trends that guided strategic forecasting and strengthened data-driven recommendations
Microeconomics & Financial Ethics - Teaching Assistant; BYU - Idaho Winter 2025
• Supported faculty in managing coursework for 100+ students, ensuring grading accuracy, consistent feedback, and improved performance tracking through streamlined Excel-based processes and organized evaluation systems.
• Delivered individualized academic support that clarified economic reasoning and financial analysis, enhancing student comprehension, engagement, and overall course outcomes through proactive communication and guidance.
PROJECTS
“White Tooth Dental” – Financial Analysis Winter 2025
• Cleaned, structured, and organized four years of financial data in R and Excel to assess the ROI of hiring a social media manager, reducing manual cleaning time by nearly 50% and enabling quicker, more accurate analysis for decision-making
• Developed and applied linear regression models to analyze profitability and liquidity scenarios, revealing key links between marketing expenses and patient acquisition that informed more strategic hiring, budgeting, and investment decisions
• Built and deployed an interactive HTML dashboard using R libraries to visualize revenue, cost, and ROI performance for the clinic’s four partners, strengthening data transparency, presentation quality, and overall financial planning efforts
LEADERSHIP EXPERIENCE AND ACTIVITIES
Corporate Finance Society – Chief Administrative Officer (Winter 2025) Winter 2024 – Present
• Led the winning team in the “Cash is King” case competition, developing a detailed Excel-based model that optimized working capital, identified liquidity gaps, and freed $2M in cash flow, improving overall financial flexibility and insight
• Streamlined society operations by coordinating 15+ events, managing communications for 50+ members, and improving participation through structured planning, consistent follow-up, and stronger collaboration among executive leaders
• Recorded and distributed 20+ sets of meeting minutes, standardized executive tracking templates, and enhanced information flow across committees, resulting in improved accountability and data-informed decision-making
Investment Society – Member Fall 2023 – Winter 2024
• Assisted in managing a simulated investment and cash portfolio, applying financial theories to liquidity management scenarios, tracking key performance metrics, and evaluating risk-adjusted returns to optimize capital deployment
• Collaborated with society members to analyze market trends, interest rate shifts, and funding strategies, deepening understanding of cash flow forecasting, portfolio management, and capital allocation within a corporate treasury context
HONORS
• Brigham Young University Idaho – Merit Scholarship Fall 2024 – Present
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Technical Skills: Excel (Advanced), Python, SQL, R, Power BI
Finance Tools: Bloomberg Terminal, Excel Modeling, Regression Analysis
Certifications: BMC, Finance Fundamentals, CFI FP&A Excel Modeling Specialization (In-progress) Relevant Coursework: Financial & Managerial Accounting, Financial & Investment Analysis, Money & Banking
Languages & Work Eligibility: Working Knowledge in Spanish, Eligible to work in the U.S. with no restrictions
